name: Furygale Flocking
oracle_text:
This spell costs {1} less to cast for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
For each opponent, create two 3/3 blue and red Elemental creature tokens with flying that attack that opponent this turn if able. They gain haste until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: For each opponent, create two 3/3 blue and red Elemental creature tokens with flying that attack that opponent this turn if able. They gain haste until end of turn.

needs.what: a 3/3 blue and red Elemental creature token with flying
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no blue-red Elemental; the nearest are elemental_2_2_g (wrong size, colour, no flying) and dragon_4_4_r_flying / angel_3_3_w_flying (wrong type and colour). The rest of the line is expressible: for_each_player over opponents with create_token amount 2 and `as`, then must_attack_player with defender {binding: each_player} duration this_turn and grant_keyword haste on the bound tokens; the cost line is cost_reduction {count: {controller: you, zone: graveyard, any_types: [Instant, Sorcery]}}
